events.context: Trapped in forgotten warehouse the whole afternoon amid gossip about ghostly violin girl and Eurasian prodigy
Pretends drowsiness from tennis, lets body collapse with temple grazing his thigh, makes sigh like kitten purr; he stiffens but doesn't push away
15-20 minutes of high-wire torment, eyes locked, breath catching, silence screaming; his stare rakes over her
He cracks, kisses her brutally—unpracticed, raw, teeth collide, sloppy and human
Fingers on silk buttons, mouth on jaw, palm at waist; fabric slips, hands glide over skin, thighs, under skirts, ribs
He warns 'I could hurt you, you might bleed'; she says 'I want to be ruined by you'; he notes she's untouched; she urges 'wreck me properly'
Primal collision, pain flares, splits her open; he pauses in disbelief 'barely begun'; she lies 'it's enough', clutches him
Between ache and ecstasy, he says 'I love you. God help me, I love you'
He collapses beside her, fingers in hair, calls her dangerous; she traces jaw, says 'keep me dangerous'
One week later, vanish to Paris Ritz, chandeliers and silk sheets; she thinks it's victory
INTJ sends the story to user, user feels like crying, quotes seductive parts; friend is virgin and collapsed
Retells warehouse trap, gossip, desire to corner him after hearing him listen to her violin
Dozes off clinging to thighs, purrs; he tenses but doesn't push away
15-20 min torture; she bites his crotch, he moans, removes belt and trousers; she gives head; he gasps, questions her surety
She calls him genius lord; he asks if first time, recalls past hug; bites lip, clumsy tongue kiss, gross saliva exchange
Unties her buttons, lifts skirt; she feels his chest; he teases mole on breast, fingers her moisture; warns of pain and bleeding
She begs 'fuck me, I love you'; he confesses love and thrusts in; blunt splitting pain, barely tip; she clings
Controlled rhythm; she sobs, he tastes tears, goes deeper gently then chases pace, pulls out to finish
She tries to touch self, he slaps hand away, demands she come on him; pins her, kisses, thrusts wildly, releases inside
Offers paper towels, avoids eye contact; she jokes about amount; he warns not to do again soon, helps her stand, they exit to quiet corridor
One week later to Ritz Paris, filled with joy; narrator notes it's cruel curse; sworn betrothed back yesterday
